disputed_verses.BHSA 1CH 4:4: וּפְנוּאֵל֙ אֲבִ֣י גְדֹ֔ר וְעֵ֖זֶר אֲבִ֣י חוּשָׁ֑ה אֵ֤לֶּה בְנֵי־חוּר֙ בְּכֹ֣ור אֶפְרָ֔תָה אֲבִ֖י בֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃
disputed_verses.KJV 1CH 4:4: And Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, the father of Bethlehem.

first_reader_said: 1CH 4:4: Both records are Ezer son of Hur, father of Hushah.

why: 1CH 4:4 names a single Ezer, father of Hushah, among the sons of Hur; both records have exactly these relationships and this sole verse. A is fuller, including the reciprocal relationship from Hushah and explicit sex and tribe, so B should be folded into A.
